distribution.rationale: CP5 taken (variant Б, owner 2026-09-11): the pack ships our own page-anchored reformulations (259 KUs) and nine decision skills, not the book text. Shingling IP gate (w=8, max-quote 25) run on the exact bytes being published: skills+README 19 files / 32045 shingles / 0 violations; brain slice 259 KU texts / 6670 shingles / 0 violations.
distribution.note: private:true and publishConfig.access=restricted were the structural pre-decision guardrails; both are lifted by this recorded decision. The book corpus itself is NOT distributed.

clean-code-intent-and-comment-contract.packaging_adapter:
## Local knowledge lookup — packaging adapter
Read [references/knowledge.md](references/knowledge.md) for the full assigned Knowledge Units and their source pages. This lookup ships with the skill.

## Output — agent adaptation, not from the book

Return the proposed decision or change, the supporting KU identifiers and source pages, the applicability limits relevant to this task, and the checks actually performed. Separate verified results from recommendations and untested assumptions. If the evidence does not support a decision, name the missing evidence instead of presenting it as verified.
